title: Retail & sales
_note: English for work (english-for-work run, 2026-11-02): written by hand in British English, not yet checked by a second reader. translations.en = short definition in simple English; deHint = German translation (the 'German' tab). Words that already exist in the English lexicon are refs with a job-specific example.
intro: The words for work in a shop: the till, the shelves, helping customers, returns, deliveries and staying safe. Every word has an example sentence from a real working day in the UK.
introEasy: Do you work in a shop? Learn the words for customers, the till and the shelves here.
tipps: Greet customers early and keep it short: “Hi, are you OK there?” or “Can I help you?” Most customers like a friendly word, but not a long one.
Say prices and amounts slowly and clearly at the till: “That's twelve pounds fifty, please.” Repeat the number if the customer looks unsure.
If you cannot answer a question, say “I'll find out for you” and ask a colleague. Do not guess about prices, returns or ingredients.
